Author: Arceuid731 / Team Wrath
Name: Wrath Combo Enhanced
Description: Learn your rotation with red damage highlights, green healing highlights, and two movable next-action windows showing their targets. Includes Wrath Combo's one-button rotations. Open settings with /wce. Enable only one Wrath Combo edition at a time.
Punchline: Wrath rotations with separate damage and healing guidance.
Changelog: With Auto-Rotation off, guidance follows your selected enemy and normal healing priorities. Remove the redundant Manual play switch; use native Auto-Rotation settings. Add teaching diagnostics and fix custom-action icons while loading.
